lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots. High density of small spots posterior to the gills, transitioning into 4-5 distinct horizontal rows of larger, more widely spaced spots along the mid-lateral flank towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal spot alignments to form a coordinate-like grid of high-intensity anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. The most prominent ridge shows a sharp intensity gradient—bright reflectance on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge—extending from above the pectoral fin to the base of the first dorsal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of small, high-luminance blobs distributed primarily across the lower and posterior regions of the first dorsal fin's silhouette; the anterior leading edge shows lower spot density.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch or excision is visible on the upper posterior margin (trailing edge) of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense micro-spotting pattern on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, which differs in scale and spatial frequency from the macro-blobs on the lateral flank.
